Original registry growth,lookup and constructors execute. Allocator uses bounded owned zeroed memory; failure notification AECEE0 intercepted only for negative cases.
Constructors and deleting destructors only; no stream file IO,Vorbis initialization or PCM in this receipt. Registry allocation explicitly freed by harness; historical global teardown not qualified.
Source header lengths physically present; no claim of safe native truncated-buffer parsing. Announcer locales are those of recorded banks,not complete region coverage.
Mutated copies of physically complete source header. No safe truncated-buffer parsing claim.

Full B22AF0 property reader and enclosing voice/parent constructors remain unqualified. Voice,remaining=-1,low latency and initial-8 are supplied as V752; filters bypass, no effects/mix/physical audio.
